text:
TAP::action
Description
This command returns or updates security token action. Returns action supplied by TAP service.
If supplied new action to set function returns previous action. Returns one of the following actions:
allow
alarm
basicPolicy
strictPolicy
jsInection
captcha
block
tcpReset
deception
Syntax
TAP
::
action
[
action
]
Examples
when
TAP_REQUEST
{
if
{
([
TAP
::
action
]
eq
"block"
)
}
{
drop
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
TAP_REQUEST
Introduced: BIGIP-15.0
